feeds.title: Lisa Appelo
feeds.description: Features articles on faith nourishment, bible study, overcoming grief and more. Lisa Appelo helps women deepen their faith in life's storms, and find gospel hope in grief and difficulties through resources and articles.

feeds.title: Dena Johnson Blog
feeds.description: Blog articles focuses on faith and hope for the Christians who are in need. Dena has walked the painful journey of almost losing her faith only to find a God who relentlessly pursued her, fought for her love and affections, and faithfully restored her life.

feeds.title: Sophie-sticated Mom
feeds.description: Blog topics cover articles on Christian lifestyle, faith, career, relationships, & affordable fashion & beauty tips for single moms. Dr. Sophia Reed started this single mom blog for sophisticated moms for single mothers who want to put her best foot forward in everything she does, including her relationships, her career, her appearance, her parenting, and her relationship with God.

feeds.title: Made New Mama Blog
feeds.description: Everything Faith, Health, Balance, Identity, and Peace for the young christian (single) mom. Blog sharing stories, wisdom, laughs, and encouragement. Made New Mama is more than just a mom blog but a place to grow your faith, challenge your perspective, and receive weekly encouragement that helps you move forward to a peace-filled life.

feeds.title: Not Consumed Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kim Sorgius and my number one desire is to help kids and families grow in faith so we will never feel consumed by life's struggles. My passion for helping families grow in faith is deep-rooted in a pretty messy life story, mercifully redeemed by our incredible God! Our mission is to help your family GROW in faith with practical resources: devotions for kids, sibling rivalry, family bonding, homeschool planning, etc.

feeds.title: Coffee with Starla
feeds.description: Covers articles on faith, mental health, parenting, forgiveness, scripture writing, homeschooling and more. Hi all! I'm Starla, the gal behind coffeewithstarla.com. As a Christian life coach, I help you figure out where you are, where you want to be and help you see your options in moving forward.

feeds.title: Grace for Single Parents
feeds.description: The blog features articles on Christian single mom parenting, lifestyle changes, faith and more. Grace for Single Parents helps with single parenting support for the unique parenting struggles and situations you face as a single parent.

feeds.title: Patti Burris
feeds.description: Blog articles focuses on Christain single motherhood, Contentment, faith, Journey as a providence, devotional series scriptures and more. Patti Burris is here to encourage you as you deepen your relationship with Christ.
